title: Harps and Horns and Happy Hearts
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The Psalms are full of happy songs,
And one says, 'Sing and play!
Make joyful music to the Lord,
And praise Him all the day!'

[Chorus]
Sing to the Lord with all your heart,
He loves your happy praise,
So hum or clap or say, 'Thank You,'
And sing through all your days.

[Verse 2]
Long ago they played harps and horns,
With hearts so full of love,
For God made all the great big world,
The earth and sky above.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes, the songs are done,
The harps and horns are still,
But in your heart a thank-You hums,
And God's love fills you still.

[Chorus]
mood: Clapping music. A bright, bouncy pulse with a little skip in it, like hands clapping along, matching a story about praising with harps and horns and happy hearts. The sway stays cheerful and open through the first two verses, inviting a child to hum along. By the last verse the bounce fades to a gentle rock, lower and slower, as the instruments in the story fall quiet.
